text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C at a gain felt rewarding, but a gain over my cost basis does not mean the sale was well timed; I should decide based on future prospects.","I should not hold a stock just to avoid admitting a loss, or sell just to protect a gain. My average cost is not a reason to trade.","My account fell and then partly recovered, but random past price changes do not predict what comes next. I should avoid frequent reactions to noise and trade only when I have a sound reason."]}
